HANEY AND SONS CLINIC - DISCHARGE SUMMARY

Patient: Megan Castro DOB: 02/12/1967 Sex: F MRN: 999691
Admit: 06/21/2026 Discharge: 06/22/2026

Principal diagnosis: Musculoskeletal injury
Secondary diagnosis: Asthma, Hypertension

Admitting diagnosis: Musculoskeletal injury
Discharge diagnosis: Musculoskeletal injury, Asthma, Hypertension

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
Megan Castro, a 59-year-old female, presented to the clinic on June 21, 202G, with complaints of musculoskeletal pain. She reports a long-standing history of asthma and hypertension, both of which are well-controlled with current medications. The patient has been experiencing musculoskeletal pain since February 22, 2020, following an acute injury. She was admitted for further evaluation and management of her musculoskeletal injury.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
1. Asthma (diagnosed on September 9, 2012) - Controlled with biologic therapy and albuterol.
2. Hypertension (diagnosed on December 16, 2008) - Controlled with hydrochlorothiazide, olmesartan, and chlorthalidone.
3. Musculoskeletal injury (since February 22, 2020) - Managed with ibuprofen.

ALLERGIES: None known

MEDICATIONS ON ADMISSION:
1. Albuterol 90 mcg inhaler as needed
2. Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg daily
3. Olmesartan 40 mg daily
4. Chlorthalidone 25 mg daily
5. Ibuprofen 600 mg as needed for pain

HOSPITAL COURSE:
The patient was admitted on June 21, 2026, for evaluation and management her musculoskeletal injury. Upon admission, blood pressure was 124/85 mmHg, and her weight was 204 pounds. Physical examination revealed normal vital signs and no acute distress. The musculoskeletal examination showed tenderness and swelling in the affected area, consistent with her reported injury.

During her hospital stay, the patient received physical therapy and pain management with ibuprofen. Her asthma and hypertension remained well-controlled throughout her stay. She was educated on the importance of regular exercise and medication adherence. The patient was encouraged to continue her current exercise regimen, which includes running 3-4 times per week.

DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS:
1. Albuterol 90 mcg inhaler as needed for asthma symptoms
2. Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg daily for hypertension
3. Olmesartan 40 daily for hypertension
4. Chlorthalidone 25 mg daily for hypertension
5. Ibuprofen 600 mg as needed pain management

DISCHARGE INSTRUCTIONS:
The patient was discharged home in stable condition on June 22, 2026. She was advised to her current medications and follow up with her primary care physician, Dr. Edward Martin,

at Haney and Sons Clinic, for further management of her musculoskeletal injury, asthma, and hypertension. She was instructed to continue her regular exercise routine and maintain a healthy lifestyle. The patient was also counseled on the importance of avoiding tobacco use and limiting alcohol intake.

SOCIAL HISTORY:
The patient reports current tobacco use, smoking cigars three times per year. She started this habit on January 21, 2011. She consumes approximately one alcoholic drink per week. Her family history is significant for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) in her father, who was diagnosed at age 65.

FOLLOW-UP:
The patient is scheduled to follow up with Dr. Edward Martin at Haney and Sons Clinic in two weeks for re-evaluation of her musculoskeletal injury and overall health maintenance. She is encouraged to contact her healthcare provider if she experiences any worsening of symptoms or new concerns.

PRIMARY CARE PHYSICIAN:
Dr. Edward Martin, Family Medicine, Haney and Sons Clinic

This discharge summary was prepared by Dr. Edward Martin, Family Medicine, Haney and Sons Clinic.
